title: Signature Relational Fabric
overview: A Signature-designed relational engine where every table carries a deterministic lineage stamp: each row records which generator, seed, and source produced it, so any query result can be traced back to its origin. Built for the JAH database network’s provenance requirements. Signature creative concept — an original database engine design by Justin Addam Higgins, not a real commercial product.
